items.title: Verdant SEO - 'Turn Content into endless Organic traffic'
items.description: A Verdant landing over a flowered green field: 'Turn Content into endless Organic traffic', 'Generate, publish, and scale high-ranking SEO pages automatically...', green Start scaling traffic, and a Dashboard card (42,642 visits, 24,987, 856,787, 675; 273,398 Monthly Visits; 5 Pages Scheduled). An SEO-autopilot hero.

items.title: Trips board - Lisbon sketch card with an upcoming rail
items.description: A 'Trips' board (Upcoming/Past): a hand-sketched 'Lisbon Getaway' card (CDG→LIS, Oct 12, K42, 14C, 6 nights, 4 travelers all checked in) beside a rail (Kyoto in Autumn, Reykjavik lights, Yerevan & Diljan) and a black 'Plan a trip' button. A travel planning board.

items.title: Invoice approvals - Ready/Posted/Rejected columns for Island Dairy
items.description: A three-column review board: Ready ('Match invoice INV-8841' Island Dairy: Milk 40 L, Butter 36 L, Cream 4 L; Approve MVR 1,008.00), Posted ('36 L approved', 'Payment queued'), Rejected ('Reject invoice INV-8841', Confirm reject). An accounts-payable flow, not a reports workspace.

items.title: Job workspace - 'ac replacement — miller residence' dispatch board
items.description: A 'quuxapilot' job board: 'ac replacement — miller residence' (8:45 am-2:00 pm, crew avatars), job checklist with struck items, site photos, job value $5,531.00, change order (+$400) and crew notes, with Mark complete. An HVAC dispatch workspace, not an AI response view.

items.title: Commerce dashboard - income, expense, orders and balance
items.description: A light admin dashboard: Total Income $160,900.90, Total Expense $20,900.90, New Orders 900, Total Balance $140,900.90, Recent Orders (Nike Airforce 1'07, SK-45, $123.87, statuses), Total Report and Recent Transactions. An e-commerce ops board, not sprint planning.

items.title: Gift modal - $250 in credits for cloud sessions
items.description: A white modal on a blue gradient: gift icon, 'Limited time', 'You've been gifted $250 in credits for cloud sessions', steps (1 Connect GitHub and choose a repository, 2 Start a cloud session), Pro/Max fine print, 'How cloud sessions work', Not now / Continue. A credits gift moment.

items.title: focus3 - 'A little focus. A fuller day.' with a 3/3 card
items.description: A cream landing for focus3: 'LESS, BUT WITH INTENTION - A little focus. A fuller day.', Start my three, and a taped 'MY FOCUS 3' card ('Jamie's little wins', three struck items, 3/3 'Enough for today.', 'Less on my list. More in my day.'). A gentle focus-app hero.

items.title: German outreach builder - campaign steps with waits and retries
items.description: A German sequence builder: 'Kampagne starten', step cards with 'Schritt löschen', message drafts ('...UX Designer:in — hättest du Lust, dich zu vernetzen?', 113/300), 'Warten 3 Tage' and 'Letzter Versuch' blocks. An outreach/campaign tool, not a type tool.
